description: Evaluate historical evidence for a supported equity hypothesis without collecting historical prices, reconstructing earnings events, running an event backtest, or calculating performance statistics yourself. Returns structured JSON with sample size, mean and median returns, positive outcome rate, methodology, source provenance, and limitations. Currently supports only pead_nordic_pre_report_drift_20d_q5 (Nordic pre-earnings price drift, top quintile Q5) at 20 or 40 trading days. Precomputed event-level research only: not an arbitrary backtest, live trading signal, or proof of investable portfolio performance.
name: get_historical_edge
